title: BIFL recommendation file
description: One file per taxonomy division under data/recommendations/. Divisions mirror the HomeGoods-Taxonomy division ids so a recommendation can be joined onto an inventory row.

id.description: HomeGoods-Taxonomy division id, e.g. 40 for Tools & Workshop.
Stable slug, unique across the whole directory. Never re-used after deletion.

product.description: Human-facing name as someone would search for it.

model.description: Null where the claim is about a brand or a whole line, not one model.

homegoods_class.description: Optional 6-digit class from HomeGoods-Taxonomy. Enables joining onto an inventory row.

verdict.description: avoid is first-class: the sub's most-upvoted content is often a durability failure or a company reneging on a lifetime claim.

claim.description: The durability claim in one sentence, in the repo's own words.

service_life_reported.description: As reported by sources, e.g. '30+ years', not an estimate of our own.

warranty.description: e.g. 'lifetime, transferable' — record what the maker states, and in caveats whether sources say it is honoured.

price_band.description: Relative to the category, not an absolute figure. Prices date; bands do not.

available_new.description: Whether the item can still be bought new. The sub's own long-running complaint is about recommendations that are only findable second-hand.

successor.description: Where available_new is false, the current model sources point to instead.

caveats.description: Anything that would change the verdict: a quality cliff after an acquisition, a region-locked warranty, a model number that looks identical but is not.

confidence.description: high: several independent, highly-rated sources agreeing. medium: one strong source. low: single unsupported mention, kept because it is a lead worth chasing.

reviewed.description: Last date a human or agent re-checked the claim against sources.

evidence.description: Every record carries its provenance. A record with no evidence is not a record.

ref.description: Fullname of the harvested item, e.g. t3_abc123 or t1_def456, so the record joins back onto harvest/.

score.description: Upvotes at harvest time. A number, not a verdict — a highly-scored joke is still a joke.

quote.description: The specific sentence the claim rests on, verbatim and trimmed.
